description: Build professional, responsive landing page in /frontend using vanilla HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Dark theme with blue/purple gradient accents inspired by Auronix webflow design. Include hero section, features, capabilities, how it works, architecture diagram placeholder, SDK code examples, performance metrics, CTA sections, and footer. Fully responsive (mobile-first CSS). No build tooling required — serve static files directly.
steps: Create frontend/index.html with semantic HTML5 structure: nav, header (hero), main (sections), footer
Create frontend/css/styles.css with dark theme design system: CSS variables for colors (dark bg, blue/purple gradients, white/gray text), typography scale, spacing scale, responsive breakpoints

Implement hero section: headline 'Agent Sandbox: Hardware-Isolated Execution for AI Agents', subheadline highlighting Firecracker microVMs and <100ms boot time, CTA buttons (Get Started, View Docs, GitHub link)

Implement features grid section: 4-6 feature cards with icons (Hardware Isolation, Millisecond Boot, Complete Linux Environment, Pre-built Templates, Ephemeral Sessions, Network Control) using CSS Grid, responsive to 1-2-3 columns
Implement 'How It Works' section: 3-step process flow (Request → VM Restore → Execution → Cleanup) with visual indicators, brief descriptions
Implement architecture diagram section: placeholder for architecture diagram (use comment or simple SVG placeholder) with caption referencing defense-in-depth isolation

Implement code example section: tabbed interface showing SDK usage examples (TypeScript SDK, REST API, MCP) using vanilla JS for tab switching, syntax-highlighted code blocks (use simple CSS styling, no external highlighter library)
Implement capabilities/interfaces section: 3-column grid for TypeScript SDK, REST API, MCP Server with brief descriptions and links
Implement performance metrics section: highlight key numbers (90ms cold start p50, 1-5ms snapshot restore, 128MB default memory, hardware-level isolation) in visually prominent cards
Implement security/isolation section: list isolation layers (dedicated kernel, network namespace, jailer, cgroups, etc.) in a structured layout
Implement CTA section: 'Ready to Get Started?' with button to GitHub repo and docs
Implement footer: project info, license (AGPL-3.0), author credit (William Law / willx.tech), links to GitHub, SDK, documentation
Add responsive CSS: mobile-first approach, breakpoints at 640px, 768px, 1024px, ensure all sections stack appropriately on mobile
Add smooth scroll behavior and minimal JavaScript for interactivity: tab switching for code examples, optional smooth scroll to sections on nav clicks
Create frontend/js/main.js for interactive behaviors (tab switching, mobile menu toggle if nav has hamburger)
Add favicon.ico or favicon.png in frontend/ root (simple geometric icon or 'AS' monogram)
Test responsive layout manually by resizing browser (document testing approach in FEAT file)
acceptance_criteria: frontend/index.html opens in browser and displays full landing page with all sections
Dark theme with blue/purple gradient accents applied throughout
Page is fully responsive: layout adapts correctly on mobile (375px), tablet (768px), and desktop (1024px+) viewports
Code example tabs switch correctly when clicked
All text content accurately represents Agent Sandbox features, capabilities, and performance metrics from README.md
No external dependencies (no npm, no frameworks, no CDN libraries except optional Google Fonts or similar)
Footer includes correct license, author, and GitHub links
verification: Open frontend/index.html in a modern browser (Chrome, Firefox, Edge) — page loads without errors
Inspect page in browser DevTools: no console errors, no broken image links, no missing CSS
Test responsive design: resize browser to 375px width (mobile), 768px (tablet), 1280px (desktop) — all sections render correctly
Click code example tabs — content switches correctly
Verify all content (features, performance numbers, security layers) matches README.md facts
